headline: Barker Heating & Air Conditioning: woman-owned Dayton HVAC company founded in 1918
summary: Barker Heating & Air Conditioning is a woman-owned heating and cooling company on Watervliet Avenue in Dayton. It installs, repairs and maintains furnaces, air conditioners and heat pumps for homes and light commercial buildings and is a Bryant Factory Authorized Dealer. The state license number on its site, 44462, matches Ohio HVAC contractor license HV.44462 in the OCILB roster we downloaded on October 29, 2026, and the City of Dayton's registered heating contractor list (active as of June 4, 2026) carries it under registration 009877.

The company says it was established in 1918, and BBB has listed it as accredited since 1948. This page lists its license and city registration, who runs it, its services and maintenance plan, and what we could not confirm, such as posted hours and a list of towns.

notes.title: Best fit
